summary.heading: Project Summary
summary.purpose_text: To automatically extract financial information such as profit share rates, maturities, fees, and rewards from natural language campaign texts published on participation banks' websites, standardize this information, and present it to users via dashboards and chatbots.
summary.problem_text: In participation banking, campaign texts are written in different formats with varying terminology, making manual comparison difficult. This delays bank employees and customers from selecting the most advantageous product.
summary.solution_text: Data collection via web scraping, Turkish text preprocessing and regex-based information extraction, intent analysis and natural language generation using the large language model provided via the competition Evren API, transforming extracted data into standardized comparable formats, and presenting results via interactive dashboards and QA chatbot.

goals.1: Data Collection: Collect 100+ campaign texts from at least 5 participation banks across at least 3 distinct product categories.
goals.2: Information Extraction Accuracy: Achieve over 90% accuracy in extracted profit rates, terms, fees, and reward amounts.
goals.3: Dashboard Development: Complete an interactive dashboard enabling interbank comparisons, filtering, and sorting capabilities.
goals.4: Chatbot Functionality: Deploy an operational chatbot answering natural language queries like 'What is Bank A's mortgage rate?' or 'Which bank has the lowest profit rate?'.
goals.5: On-Premise Compatibility: Verify system operation on a single local server without external dependencies.
